meta.label: Keyword facet: a filter, not a placement. It lists cards that carry a keyword wherever they are placed; it changes no group and no figure.
meta.note: The parser's keyword list is narrower than Scryfall's: it holds keyword abilities only. Scryfall's list also includes keyword actions and ability words (Mill, Scry, Landfall, Fight, Investigate and so on), so a card can be a "Landfall" card on Scryfall and have no keyword here.
meta.source: the parsed `keywords` field of each card record (faces merged to the oracle id, recovered cards included)
